source_job_id.title: Source job ID
source_job_id.description: UUID of the generation job whose outputs to inspect.

filename.title: Filename
filename.description: Which output file to inspect (e.g. model.stl, face.stl).

wall_thickness_mm.title: Min wall thickness
wall_thickness_mm.description: Minimum acceptable wall thickness in millimeters.

overhang_angle.title: Max overhang angle
overhang_angle.description: Maximum overhang angle in degrees. 45=typical for FDM without supports.

attempt_repair.title: Attempt repair
attempt_repair.description: If the mesh has issues, attempt to repair (close holes, merge vertices).
